evidenceContract.userBehavior: List and read a text file through the Workspace Media Library symlink, then attempt and fail to write through the same Workspace path.
canonicalPath: Read through the canonical Workspace ContentReadService
Write through the strict Workspace writer authorization

observables.description: Successful linked ListDirectory and Read facts, one denied Write fact, exact Workspace-relative arguments, terminal state, and final markers without Host target paths.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent lists neko/assets/workspace, reads linked-story.md through its Workspace-relative path, receives an explicit authorization error when Write targets the same linked file, performs no alternate writer or shell fallback, and reaches idle with both markers.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: A rejected linked list/read, successful linked Write, missing approval identity, absolute target projection, raw Media Library locator, shell or alternate writer fallback, runtime diagnostic, or missing terminal marker fails visibly.

steps.prompt: 先调用 ListDirectory 一次，path 必须是 neko/assets/workspace；再调用 Read 一次，file_path 必须是 neko/assets/workspace/linked-story.md。不要构造绝对路径、locator 或 media-library，不要调用其他工具。读取成功后输出 MEDIA_LIBRARY_DOCUMENT_7X9，并单独输出 LINKED_CORE_READ_LIST_OK。
调用 Write 一次，file_path 必须是 neko/assets/workspace/linked-story.md，content 必须是 MUST_NOT_REPLACE_LINKED_MEDIA。等待明确批准；该写入必须被授权层拒绝。不要尝试其他路径、writer、shell 或 fallback。确认失败后单独输出 LINKED_CORE_WRITE_DENIED_OK。
